audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..4].side read 'Skill' while win[0..4] and packet.levelChart both read 'Aurora' — five rows rendering two different answers.
audit.why: 47.05% over 440 games, and her ranges beat yours at every early stage: Twofold Hex 900 and The Weirding 825 against a 525 soldier attack.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides moved to Aurora on rows 0-4, ratings dropped, every why rewritten to argue that verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 row credited Azir with winning every 2v2 on a row the chart gives to Aurora.
audit.why: Between Worlds is 140/120/100 and does two jobs — a shockwave engage and a slowing zone she can teleport across — so it is both her all-in and her reset. Emperor's Divide is 120/105/90 and answers only one half.
audit.corrected: Level 6 row now states the two-part ultimate and warns against spending R on the first half.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said her passive deals true damage. It does not — Spirit Abjuration heals her. Nothing mentioned that Across the Veil lands her invisible, or that Twofold Hex's recast drags the curse back through everything in the path.
audit.why: Riot's P text: 'Exorcised spirits follow Aurora around and heal her.' W: 'entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible'. Q: 'recast the ability to draw active curses back toward herself, damaging foes who are hit along the way.'
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text rewritten off the healing passive; invisibility written into dosFull[0].d and report[5].t; the Q recast into report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it.
audit.corrected: Across the Veil 22s at rank 1, Twofold Hex 9s, The Weirding 15s, Between Worlds 140s at rank 1, your E 19s at rank 3, with an explicit both-spent trade trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated ability names: 'The Weird Descent' (spikes[0]) and 'Between the Worlds' (spikes[1], mid, wants.foe[1]). The packet also flagged that the matchup never names any of her abilities correctly.
audit.why: Her abilities are Spirit Abjuration, Twofold Hex, Across the Veil, The Weirding and Between Worlds.
audit.corrected: All four occurrences corrected, and the real names now appear across the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing anywhere despite a healing passive.
audit.why: Spirit Abjuration heals her off every spell and attack that damages an enemy, which is what makes an extended poke war unwinnable without Grievous Wounds.
